name: BARENTS SEA — ARCTIC SHIELD
description: A carrier group north of the North Cape faces three surface combatants and a fictional mixed air detachment operating from Kola airfields. Neutralize the surface group while keeping the carrier and civilian traffic safe. Aircraft and the submarine remain threats, but they are not mandatory victory targets. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

objectives.text: Neutralize the three opposing surface combatants while preserving the carrier and civilian traffic.
